evidence.quote: Stairs & wheelchair access: Some areas of the venue are accessed by stairs and, unfortunately, there is no wheelchair access to these areas.

findings.value: Some areas are reached by stairs with no wheelchair access, and the live room is on the second floor. There is seating, no dedicated quiet or safe area, and companion tickets are arranged with the promoter. Contact the venue before visiting if you have access questions.

evidence.quote: Seating: We have seating available within the venue.
Quiet areas: Please note that we do not have a dedicated quiet or safe area.
If you require a companion ticket, please contact the event promoter directly before the event.
Located on the second floor, our 150-capacity live room has seen a whole host of events

not_found: accessibility.step_free: the contact page says only that some areas have no wheelchair access; it does not say whether the live room or the bar is step-free, so it stays empty

notes: Capacity 150 is the second-floor live room, according to the hire page, not the whole pub. Please check before publishing it as the venue's capacity. The contact page is proposed as the access page because it holds the venue's only access section. The CAMRA WhatPub page has no access line. Step-free stays empty, as the profile already has it.
